correctness.rationale: The full graph and complex are reconstructed. A link-induction in flag complexes gives sharp 8-vertex nonzero H3 support, and equality forces four missing edges in a perfect matching, i.e. a fourfold S0 join. Exhaustive 36-path four-pack testing yields exactly 93 carriers. The 1037-face directed Hasse graph has 507 acyclic pairs and precisely one critical vertex and 22 critical 3-cells, proving an integral wedge, not just finite-field homology. Exact signed cycles, all unit-pivot Morse reductions, column gcds one, Hermite form I22, a 22-column determinant +1 and Smith form (2,2) for the three exceptional triples certify integrality and every stated boundary.

value.rationale: Shortest nonzero induced homology support is a canonical geometric invariant for matching complexes. Classifying all 93 minimizers and their automorphism orbits yields a complete natural integer generator census for the smallest Dürer matching-complex spheres. The exceptional three orbit triples have full rational rank yet Smith quotient (Z/2)^2, a substantive two-dimensional parity obstruction invisible to rational homology, abstract wedge type or generic join construction. The integral index distinction is mathematically meaningful without needing a general family theorem.
